assessment: The sealed round2 preparation matches the bounded plan. The active entrance requires this package's independent preparation review, a new round2 authority, fresh admission proof, and exact same-candidate predecessor bindings before native backend construction. No Critical or Important defect was identified in the reviewed preparation change. This verdict grants preparation credit only.

strengths.detail: Predecessor validation distinguishes the unchanged raw PENDING terminal from its independent result PASS and registration. It checks round1 and candidate identity, mechanical/factual/target/file/final-claim/cleanup verdicts, runtime and preparation bindings, model/digest, one CLI without retry, terminal/review hashes, and exactly one previously credited positive.

All three predecessor receipts are mandatory sealed runtime dependencies. The new authority must contain exactly the returned predecessor binding, including the registration hash. Package review, scope, candidate/model, proof hash, admission age, seven protected identities, and exclusive case state are checked before native construction.

The active execution path preserves exclusive consumption, repeated admission checks, final pre-CLI time sampling, effects/cleanup/audit attempts, postflight boundaries, and terminal failure retention. Mechanical success still produces PENDING_FACT_REVIEW with acceptance_credit false.

The backend is byte-identical to the parent and imports CASE/SCOPE from the new entrance. Its active path uses the candidate guard directly, binds runtime module locations, checks seven protected process identities and model metadata, validates two owned windows and fixed text/selection, revalidates before activation and CLI submission, submits one CLI, and preserves external file/window readback and cleanup.

The retained historical controller entrance still requires its separate recovery manifest, schema-2 authority, ledger and historical review bindings. The new round2 authority is not a grant for that historical path. The active AcceptanceBackend does not invoke controller.execute or controller.source_check.

The added tests exercise round2 admission with pending new facts, semantically ineligible predecessors even after resealing and rebinding, omitted predecessor dependencies, wrong authority receipt hashes, and rejection of a prior round1 authority before backend construction.

Retained assertions cover actual backend call ordering with fake native boundaries, fixed CLI arguments and timeout metadata, text/identity/selection drift, protected/model/listener drift, invalid manual handoff, cleanup despite marker errors, and admission expiry during command/observation or binding reads.

Documentation accurately separates prior positive1of3 from this preparation, explains the byte-exact runtime reuse and two adjusted test modules, and explicitly limits the stored offline results and reused product regressions.
